implementationPolicy.strategy: Incremental convergence through existing AppShell, design tokens, shared primitives, workspace state, domain stores, writers, and approval controllers.
forbid: source fallback that hides read/provenance failure
implementationPolicy.settingsPolicy: Do not mutate .obsidian during Wave0. A later setting comparison requires byte-exact backup, exact one-variable diff, explicit per-change approval, cold/warm repetitions, and rollback proof.

rows.contract: personal always resolves to HUB/60 Personal.md and journal always resolves to HUB/70 Journal.md through one registry-derived route table.
rows.change: Remove duplicated caller paths; expose a route equality check/receipt and preserve exact continuation target metadata.
acceptance: All known callers produce the same id/path pair.
Launcher, Home, WorkspaceSwitcher, Object Engine, and morning brief open the expected hub.
Invalid route ids produce a scoped error rather than opening a neighboring hub.

rows.contract: Every required/optional module exposes loading, success, empty-after-success, scoped error, retry, and stale/disposed states.
rows.change: Centralize retry and falsy/rejection handling; preserve shell geometry and previous projection while retrying; distinguish sync-pending from product failure.
acceptance: No dependency failure renders as a valid empty state.
Retry reuses canonical mount and does not duplicate handlers/timers.
aria-busy/live status and Korean recovery copy are present.
Previous content remains visible where safe.
verification: dependency reject/retry tests for Home, Reading, Project, Personal, Journal, Region

rows.contract: Explorer mount, hydration, AI brief, projection, destroy, and remount share a lifecycle token and preserve scroll/focus.
rows.change: Add abort/invalidate semantics, duplicate activation guard, stable projection nodes or snapshot/restore, and generation checks.
acceptance: Old responses cannot paint a remounted Explorer.
Search/selection/brief/hydration preserve active focus and pane scroll.
Repeated activation while busy is ignored or coalesced with visible state.

rows.contract: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly, and Yearly use stable staged loading/error/empty/retry behavior with stale-version protection.
rows.change: Keep prior projection during reads, add polite busy/error/retry status, preserve action availability where input is valid, and guard callbacks by period/mount version.
acceptance: Weekly failures do not erase usable saved content.
Daily/long-period failures expose retry and scoped reason.
Empty is shown only after successful read.
Closing/reopening restores valid period/date context.
verification: failure injection tests for each period
retry and stale response integration test

rows.contract: Readiness counts use canonical selected-period bounds and independent Direction sources.
rows.change: Replace year-prefix aliasing with exact quarter/month bounds and preserve completed-record filtering.
acceptance: Quarterly includes only Monthly records within selected quarter.
Directions are counted from their own source, not QUARTERLY file count.
Cross-year and cross-quarter fixtures remain deterministic.

rows.contract: Candidate source-open is read-only; approve/reject remains store/controller-owned; removal returns focus deterministically.
rows.change: Add next-candidate → launcher/result fallback and exact source/candidate route identity.
acceptance: Approval/rejection never silently creates a second writer.
After removal, focus lands on next candidate or named fallback.
Source open does not mutate candidate state.
Returned focus is the invoking control when no candidate remains.

rows.contract: Compact focus actions reveal the current list pane, target the exact workspace card, and return focus to the opener.
rows.change: Scope lookup to current mount, coordinate pane visibility before scroll, and use shared scroll/focus helpers.
acceptance: Below 1024px focus action is visibly effective.
Multiple Reading leaves cannot steal the target.
Hidden panes do not own scroll.

rows.contract: People/Places rows distinguish source, candidate, and approved Knowledge with exact provenance and candidate-focused review.
rows.change: Add typed row metadata, exact path/status/quality/source refs, and explicit review handoff; do not auto-create candidates from People context.
acceptance: People/Places can open the exact candidate review target.
Approved rows open approved Knowledge without candidate mutation.
No-link pages are omitted from typed buckets.
Approval remains behind the existing human gate.

rows.contract: Project creation projects the first unfinished executable action consistently to card, Today, Object, and return handoff.
rows.change: Persist or derive next_action without erasing workflow steps; make status/refresh failures recoverable and connect Home refresh callback.
acceptance: A valid wizard result shows a non-empty next action.
Card, Today, and Object agree on action/path.
Failed write re-enables controls and preserves draft/state.
Close/back returns focus and makes destination explicit.

rows.contract: Read failure is a typed per-item error; empty is only a successful empty read.
rows.change: Preserve metadata and show concise row-level error/retry without fabricating body content.
acceptance: Dataview/Vault failure is distinguishable from empty note.
Retry preserves person/venue identity.
Source provenance remains visible when body read fails.

rows.contract: People/Places tabs provide AdaptiveTabs-equivalent keyboard semantics, durable active state, and compact touch targets.
rows.change: Use shared tab primitive/semantics, persist active tab, and add focus transfer/Back behavior.
acceptance: Arrow/Home/End and Tab semantics work.
Below 768px primary tab target is at least the shared touch target.
Reopen restores valid tab and invalid tab resets safely.
verification: compact dimension and state persistence test

rows.contract: Places has one active scroll owner and token-sized controls in narrow layouts.
rows.change: Remove competing pane overflow, use shared toolbar/field/button primitives, and preserve selected venue/focus.
acceptance: Touch/wheel gesture has one predictable owner.
Controls meet shared compact target.
CJK/long venue text wraps without horizontal overflow.

rows.contract: Project cards use theme aliases and native accessible icon controls.
rows.change: Replace raw colors/RGB and emoji delete span with shared tokens/icon button.
acceptance: No raw presentation color remains in the card path.
Delete is keyboard-operable with accessible name/focus.
Compact target meets shared size.

rows.contract: Repeated cards, sections, actions, and icons compose from theme tokens, shared rhythm, CJK-safe wrapping, and accessible names.
rows.change: Replace ad-hoc radii/grids/colors/emoji/machine IDs with shared primitives without changing domain projections.
acceptance: Knowledge panels, Weekly chrome, Launcher, and Auction follow token aliases.
Machine identifiers are not user-facing.
High contrast and CJK/long URL rendering remain legible.

rows.contract: Each layout has one active scroll owner, toolbar/safe-area clearance, and shared compact targets.
rows.change: Remove local overflow overrides, make hidden panes non-scrolling, and compose controls from shared touch primitives.
acceptance: No nested competing scroll owner in audited surfaces.
Bottom actions remain reachable under mobile toolbar/safe area.
Primary compact controls meet shared target and visible focus.
verification: physical mobile remains unclaimed until real evidence

rows.contract: One-shot scope request is acknowledged only after destination readiness, survives failure/retry, and clears after success.
rows.change: Add request status/ack, preserve filter/focus metadata through loader error, and make scope consumption explicit.
acceptance: Auction receives exact Region scope after modules are ready.
Failed load can retry the same request.
Successful consumption clears stale scope before unrelated reopen.

rows.contract: Polling is mount-scoped, cancellable, bounded, and exposes terminal error/retry.
rows.change: Centralize timers/polling and disposal; preserve prior content while retrying.
acceptance: Leaving Auction cancels timers.
Timeout/error has retry and reason.
No detached poller updates a remount.

rows.contract: Decision modal stays open until atomic persistence and provenance result is known.
rows.change: Validate headings, perform atomic write boundary, show pending/error/success, and preserve retryable draft.
acceptance: Body/frontmatter partial failure cannot present success.
Write failure leaves modal open with retry.
Successful result has source/result receipt.

rows.contract: Auction actions are native, accessible, token-sized, and theme-derived.
rows.change: Replace span/div actions and raw color/emoji presentation with shared buttons/icons and focus styles.
acceptance: Keyboard reaches every edit/delete/bid/research action.
Compact actions meet target.
High-contrast/theme rendering uses aliases only.

rows.contract: Workout startup is read-only and derived cache mutation is explicit/background with failure visibility.
rows.change: Remove read-side cache writes; instrument or schedule explicit derivation separately.
acceptance: Opening Workout does not write Vault files.
Derived cache behavior is separately attributable and retryable.
First shell/action readiness does not wait for optional cache mutation.

rows.contract: Optional health tabs report available, loading, unavailable, error, and retry states with mount isolation.
rows.change: Add tab-scoped lifecycle token, preserve busy state until settle, and keep successful siblings visible.
acceptance: Missing optional module is visible as unavailable/error, not absent.
Running tab never flashes blank before data settles.
Old tab response cannot repaint a new tab/mount.

rows.contract: Dirty draft, pending save, save failure, retry, completion, and discard are explicit.
rows.change: Retain draft in memory on failure, gate completion on save or explicit discard, and expose retry.
acceptance: Latest set cannot be lost silently.
Completion cannot claim saved while write pending/failed.
Retry preserves input and focus.

rows.contract: Region mounts shell before bounded scan/hash work and reports scan count/bytes/time separately.
rows.change: Bound/defer noncritical reads and hashes; emit durable non-Vault receipts bound to source/settings hash.
acceptance: First actionable control is available before optional intelligence completes.
Scan/hash budget and over-budget status are visible in receipt.
No physical-mobile claim is made without device evidence.

rows.contract: Region load/filter/compare uses mount-safe lifecycle and recoverable sync-pending/error/retry states.
rows.change: Preserve selected region/focus/scroll, invalidate stale updates, and classify iCloud delivery vs product failure.
acceptance: Filter/compare preserves focus and scroll.
Module failure exposes retry and request context.
Destination handoff can replay after recovery.

rows.contract: Popup is a safe, focus-managed dialog and clipboard/source command failures are recoverable.
rows.change: Use shared modal/focus primitive, escape untrusted values, handle clipboard rejection, and restore opener focus.
acceptance: Markup in Vault data renders as text.
Focus enters/leaves labelled dialog correctly.
Escape/back/close restores opener.
Clipboard denial shows fallback status.

rows.contract: Inbox remains standalone but provides an explicit review queue action into the existing Object creator and a reversible close/back flow.
rows.change: Add row/selection action, confirmation before close, pending/success/error/retry, focus restore, and ‘검증 대기 열기’/close affordances; archive remains out of scope.
acceptance: Candidate/source row can launch existing creator without duplicate writer.
Save success is visible and opens/reopens review only on explicit action.
Review queue can be closed and returns focus to the invoking action.
Failure leaves retryable context.

rows.contract: Product/data/projection/render/readiness/external startup phases are independently timed and durably indexed outside Vault.
rows.change: Define schemaVersion, source/settings hashes, control clock, phase durations, counts/bytes, action readiness, warm/cold campaign authority, and non-perturbing receipt export.
acceptance: Receipts distinguish external Obsidian/plugin startup from product work.
Cold/warm runs are reproducible and bound to immutable source/settings hashes.
Receipt collection does not change the measured Vault path.
Physical mobile status remains unclaimed until user/device evidence.

rows.contract: Settings comparisons are explicit, one-variable, reversible, and attributable.
rows.change: Create external byte-exact backups and a settings change manifest; compare only approved variables one at a time, with no silent tab/plugin deletion or reordering.
acceptance: Baseline hashes are recorded before mutation.
Every mutation has explicit approval and an exact diff.
Cold/warm timing repeats before/after and rollback restores original bytes/hash.
No result is reported as a product fix without phase evidence.

waveOrder.name: audit and baseline
waveOrder.exit: reports checked in; contract audit passes

waveOrder.name: continuity and recoverability
waveOrder.exit: P1 journeys have explicit success/error/retry/focus contracts and tests

waveOrder.name: visual and responsive convergence
waveOrder.exit: shared tokens/primitives/one-scroll/touch semantics adopted without domain rewrite

waveOrder.name: measurement and mobile attribution
waveOrder.exit: controlled receipts separate product cost from Obsidian/plugin/iCloud effects and settings rollback is proven

wave0NonGoals: No product source behavior change in G001.
No automatic People/Places candidate generation without Evidence.
No archive policy change for Inbox.
